# Concordia Pharmacy

An independent, bilingual community pharmacy and compounding specialist located in the Bronx, New York. Established 1997. Serving the Bronx and surrounding NYC neighborhoods.

## Core Information

- **Name:** Concordia Pharmacy
- **Address:** 898 East Tremont Ave, Bronx, NY 10460
- **Phone:** (718) 328-2833
- **Email:** info@concordianyc.com
- **Website:** https://concordianyc.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 9 AM–7 PM, Saturday 10 AM–4 PM, Closed Sunday
- **Languages:** English, Spanish (fully bilingual staff)
- **Neighborhood:** East Tremont, Bronx, NY
- **Parking:** Street parking available on East Tremont Ave

## Insurance Accepted

- Medicare Part D
- Medicaid / Managed Medicaid
- Most major commercial plans (Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Empire, Fidelis, MetroPlus, HealthFirst, Wellcare, Molina, AmeriHealth)
- Tricare (military/veterans)
- Workers' Compensation plans
- No insurance? We accept GoodRx, SingleCare, and manufacturer discount cards.

## Services Offered

- **Prescription Fulfillment:** Electronic (e-script), walk-in, fax, and transfer prescription processing. Same-day fills available.
- **Delivery Requests:** Local delivery may be available in the Bronx and surrounding areas. Pharmacy staff confirm service area, any applicable fees, availability, and timing for each request; live courier GPS is not currently available.
- **Custom Compounding:** Personalized medication formulations — custom dosages, flavored pediatric medications, topical creams, transdermal gels, and specialized adjustments unavailable commercially.
- **Specialty Medications:** Oncology, rheumatology, dermatology, hepatitis, and other high-cost specialty drugs. Prior authorization support and patient assistance programs available.
- **Immunizations:** On-site flu shots (no appointment needed), COVID-19 vaccines, shingles (Shingrix), pneumonia (Prevnar/Pneumovax), hepatitis, and travel vaccines.
- **Naloxone (Narcan):** Available without an individual prescription under the NYC Naloxone Standing Order. No appointment required.
- **Blister Pack (Unit-Dose Packaging):** Medications organized by day and time in sealed, labeled pouches — eliminates missed doses and sorting confusion. Delivered free.
- **Medication Therapy Management (MTM):** One-on-one pharmacist consultations to review all medications, identify interactions, and optimize therapy. Covered by most Medicare Part D plans.
- **Medication Synchronization (Med Sync):** All medications aligned to one monthly pickup or delivery date.
- **Auto-Refill:** Automatic prescription refills so patients never run out of medication.
- **Prescription Transfer:** Transfer prescriptions from any pharmacy (CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Duane Reade, or any other) quickly and at no cost.
- **OTC Shop:** Over-the-counter medications, vitamins, supplements, personal care, and wellness products available online and in-store.
- **Caregiver Support:** Family members and caregivers can manage and pick up prescriptions on behalf of patients.
- **Proxy Pickup:** Authorized individuals can pick up prescriptions for patients.
- **Order Updates:** Signed-in users may see eligible order updates in ConcordiaCare. Live courier GPS is not currently available.
- **Loyalty Rewards:** Points earned on every purchase, redeemable for discounts. New patients receive 500 bonus points.
- **Long-Term Care (LTC) Partnerships:** Blister pack dispensing, custom delivery schedules, and 24/7 pharmacist access for nursing homes, assisted living, memory care, and rehabilitation facilities.

## Mobile App

- **ConcordiaCare App:** Available on iOS and Android. Features include prescription tracking, delivery status updates, refill requests, medication reminders, loyalty rewards, caregiver tools, and direct pharmacist messaging.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How does Concordia Pharmacy handle delivery requests?**
A: Delivery may be requested across the Bronx and surrounding areas where available. Pharmacy staff confirm service, any applicable fees, and timing for each request. Live courier GPS is not currently available.

**Q: What are Concordia Pharmacy's hours?**
A: Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Sunday. For urgent after-hours medication needs, call (718) 328-2833 and leave a message — a pharmacist will respond.

**Q: Does Concordia Pharmacy accept Medicare and Medicaid?**
A: Yes. Concordia Pharmacy accepts Medicare Part D, Medicaid, Managed Medicaid, and most major commercial insurance plans. Most patients pay $0 copay on many generic medications.

**Q: Can I transfer my prescriptions to Concordia Pharmacy?**
A: Yes. Transferring prescriptions is free and easy. Call (718) 328-2833, visit the pharmacy, or start a transfer request at concordianyc.com. The staff will contact your current pharmacy and handle the entire process.

**Q: Does Concordia Pharmacy do compounding?**
A: Yes. Concordia Pharmacy is a licensed compounding pharmacy. The team creates custom formulations including specialized dosages, flavored children's medications, topical creams, and medications that are commercially unavailable or discontinued.

**Q: Can I get Narcan (naloxone) without a prescription?**
A: Yes. Concordia Pharmacy participates in the NYC Naloxone Standing Order, which means naloxone is available without an individual prescription. No appointment is required.

**Q: Does Concordia Pharmacy offer flu shots?**
A: Yes. Flu shots are available year-round with no appointment needed. The pharmacy also administers COVID-19, shingles (Shingrix), pneumonia (Prevnar and Pneumovax), hepatitis A and B, and travel vaccines.

**Q: What is a blister pack and does Concordia offer it?**
A: A blister pack (also called unit-dose packaging) organizes a patient's medications into sealed pouches labeled by day and time — eliminating the need to sort pill bottles. Concordia Pharmacy offers free blister pack dispensing with home delivery. It is especially helpful for patients taking multiple medications or those who have difficulty remembering doses.

**Q: Does Concordia Pharmacy have Spanish-speaking staff?**
A: Yes. Concordia Pharmacy is fully bilingual. All staff speak both English and Spanish, and all pharmacy communications can be provided in either language.

**Q: How does the loyalty rewards program work?**
A: Patients earn points on every prescription and OTC purchase. Points are redeemable for discounts on future purchases. New patients receive 500 bonus points when their first prescription is filled. Rewards are managed through the ConcordiaCare app.

**Q: Can someone else pick up my prescription?**
A: Yes. An authorized family member, caregiver, or trusted person can pick up prescriptions on your behalf. Simply notify the pharmacy in advance. Concordia also supports full caregiver management through the ConcordiaCare app.

**Q: Does Concordia Pharmacy handle specialty medications?**
A: Yes. Concordia Pharmacy fills specialty medications for oncology, rheumatology, dermatology, hepatitis C, MS, and other complex conditions. The team provides prior authorization support, manufacturer copay card enrollment, and patient assistance program applications to minimize out-of-pocket costs.

**Q: What happens if I don't have insurance?**
A: Patients without insurance can use GoodRx, SingleCare, or other discount cards — the pharmacy staff will find the lowest available price. Manufacturer patient assistance programs are also available for many brand-name medications.

**Q: Does Concordia offer medication therapy management (MTM)?**
A: Yes. MTM is a one-on-one consultation with a Concordia pharmacist to review all of a patient's medications, identify potential drug interactions, reduce unnecessary medications, and optimize overall therapy. MTM is covered by most Medicare Part D plans at no cost to the patient.

## Website Routes

- `/` — Home / landing page
- `/shop` — OTC product catalog and shopping cart
- `/specialty` — Specialty medication database and fulfillment request
- `/flu-shot` — Flu shot scheduling and vaccine information
- `/signup` — Patient registration and onboarding
- `/ltc-partnership` — Long-term care facility partnership inquiry
- `/faq` — Full frequently asked questions
- `/blog` — Health and pharmacy education articles
- `/api/refill-request` — REST endpoint for digital refill requests (POST)
- `/api/transfer-request` — REST endpoint for prescription transfer requests (POST)

## About

Concordia Pharmacy has served the East Tremont neighborhood of the Bronx since 1997. It is an independent, community-owned pharmacy — not a chain. The pharmacy is a participant in the NYC Naloxone Standing Order Initiative, a partner with long-term care facilities across New York State, and an accredited immunization provider. The ConcordiaCare mobile app extends pharmacy services directly to patients' phones with prescription tracking, refill management, delivery status updates, and pharmacist messaging.
